chunks: It is He who created you, though one of you is an infidel and one of you a believer; yet God perceives what you do.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about God's knowledge of believers and disbelievers?
ai.summary: In Surah Al-Taghabun, this verse underscores the divine wisdom behind the coexistence of faith and disbelief, framing it as a test of human choice rather than a defect in creation. Shia scholarship often interprets 'God is Seeing' (Basir) here as an invitation to self-reflection, reminding believers that their ultimate success depends on aligning their actions with divine awareness. This duality serves as a precursor to the Day of Reckoning, where the 'mutual disillusion' of the world will be revealed.
